race.comment: SENSATIONAL SECRET (13) was a dominant maiden winner two back before closing off strongly into the placings here two weeks ago. That form may have just been franked in the race prior with Jacks On Ice. Is fit and firing and is the one to beat. UPTOWN MONK (12) was clearly below his best here first up when failing as favourite. He's since gone back to the trials and looks much better suited rising to this trip second up. Can improve sharply. WIND RUSH (9) returns and while he doesn't do a lot of winning, he's a consistent gelding. Fitted with just the one trial off a short break and can make his presence felt. YOU SEXY THING (10) was good in her stable debut here two weeks ago and should be further improved. Right in the mix. YASUKE (1) lacks early speed but can cause a late scare if the pace is genuine.
